name: CE_BAT_TRANSFERS
description: This table contains the details of the bank account transfer and ad hoc payment transactions.

columns.name: TRANSFER_ID
columns.description: Unique sequence generated for the transfer transaction.

columns.name: SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: This column identifies whether bank transfer values are populated from Rest service or User interface. valid values are from the lookup ORA_CE_BAT_CREATION_SOURCE

columns.name: PAYMENT_FUNCTION_CODE
columns.description: The payment function used for bank account transfer or ad hoc payment. Valid values are from IBY_PAYMENT_FUNCTIONS lookup: CASH_PAYMENT and AD_HOC_PAYMENT.

columns.name: AD_HOC_PAYMENT_NUM
columns.description: Unique sequence number of Ad Hoc Payment.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_TRANSFER_NUM
columns.description: Unique sequence number of Bank Account Transfer.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether to raise accounting event when Bank Account Transfer and Ad Hoc Payment reconciled.

columns.name: OFFSET_CCID
columns.description: Offset general ledger account to be used when accounted.

columns.name: CASH_CCID
columns.description: Cash general ledger account to be used when accounted.

columns.name: IS_SETTLED_WITH_IBY_FLAG
columns.description: Identifies if payment needs to be settled with Oracle Fusion Payments.

columns.name: FROM_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of the disbursement bank account.

columns.name: FROM_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount paid by the disbursement bank account.

columns.name: PROFILE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the payment profile selected from Oracle Fusion Payments' table.

columns.name: TRANSFER_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of transfer. Valid values are BAT for bank account transfer and AHP for ad hoc payment.

columns.name: EXT_BANK_ACCT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of external bank account from Oracle Fusion Payments for this transfer or payment.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_DATE
columns.description: Transfer or payment date of the transaction.

columns.name: MEMO
columns.description: Additional information added about the bank account transfer or the ad hoc payment.

columns.name: PAYMENT_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the payment request.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Bank account transfer status. Valid values are: New, Validated/Invalid, Pending Approval, Approved/Rejected, Settlement in Process/Recorded, Settled/Failed.

columns.name: PAYMENT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of the receiving bank account.

columns.name: PAYMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount received by the receiving bank account

columns.name: PAYMENT_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Payment method selected. Possible values are CHECK, EFT, Wire and others.

columns.name: FROM_BANK_ACCT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the disbursement bank.

columns.name: FROM_EXTERNAL_TRX_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the external transaction generated for the disbursement bank account.

columns.name: PAYEE_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the Payee's party.

columns.name: PAYEE_PARTY_SITE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the Payee's party site.

columns.name: FROM_ORG_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the business unit of the disbursement account.

columns.name: TO_BANK_ACCT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the receiving account.

columns.name: TO_EXTERNAL_TRX_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the external transaction generated for the receiving bank account.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Exchange rate used to convert the payment amount to the disbursement account currency.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Type of exchange rate used to convert the payment amount to the disbursement account currency.

columns.name: SOURCE_CONVERSION_RATE
columns.description: The conversion rate used between the source bank currency and the ledger currency on the bank transfer transaction.

columns.name: SOURCE_CONVERSION_RATE_TYPE
